tokens.name: navy-50
tokens.usage: Brand tint: selected table row, active nav item background, info banner. Text on it: ink, navy-600, text-secondary.

tokens.name: navy-100
tokens.usage: Border on navy-50 fills; hover fill for ghost buttons on white.

tokens.name: navy-600
tokens.usage: Brand colour. Primary buttons, links, active nav text, checked controls, the logo tile. 10.1:1 on surface-0, 9.3:1 on surface-25, 8.9:1 on navy-50.

tokens.name: navy-700
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of navy-600 fills and links.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and headings on surface-0, surface-25, surface-50 and navy-50 (14:1 or more). Also the marketing site's dark band.

tokens.name: teal-600
tokens.usage: Accent. The focus ring (solid 2px, at least 4.7:1 on every light surface) and the 'free bay' in the logo. Text only on surface-0 (5.4:1).

tokens.name: teal-50
tokens.usage: Accent tint for new-feature callouts and the marketing site's highlight panels. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: teal-300
tokens.usage: Accent on dark only: the free bay on the reversed logo, the CTA on the marketing site's ink band (10.8:1 on ink, with ink text). Never on white.

tokens.name: on-teal-300
tokens.usage: Text on a teal-300 fill.

tokens.name: on-navy
tokens.usage: Text and icons on navy-600, navy-700, ink and every solid status fill.

tokens.name: surface-0
tokens.usage: Cards, tables, panels, modals, inputs.

tokens.name: surface-25
tokens.usage: Page background behind cards in the console and apps.

tokens.name: surface-50
tokens.usage: Subtle fills: table header, skeleton base, disabled input, Maintenance chip.

tokens.name: line-100
tokens.usage: Hairline borders between cards, rows and sections. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-300
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, selects, checkboxes, secondary buttons): 3.6:1 on surface-0, 3.3:1 on surface-25 (WCAG non-text contrast).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Descriptions, labels, table secondary columns. 7.6:1 on surface-0, 7.0:1 on surface-25.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Help text, placeholders, timestamps, 'Updated 12s ago'. 6.0:1 on surface-0, 5.5:1 on surface-25.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels only (exempt from contrast). Never for information.

tokens.name: success-600
tokens.usage: Solid fill for Allowed (gate) and success toasts, with on-navy text (5.0:1).

tokens.name: success-700
tokens.usage: Text and icons on success-50 (6.4:1): Vacant chip, 'Approved' badge.

tokens.name: success-300
tokens.usage: Success icon on dark (ink) toasts only (11.4:1 on ink).

tokens.name: success-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind success-700: Vacant tiles and chips, success banner.

tokens.name: danger-600
tokens.usage: Solid fill for Refused (gate), Occupied tiles and destructive buttons, with on-navy text (6.5:1). Also text on surface-0 and danger-50 (5.6:1).

tokens.name: danger-700
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of danger-600 fills.

tokens.name: danger-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind danger-600 text: error banners, field error background, Occupied chip.

tokens.name: warning-600
tokens.usage: Solid fill for Reserved tiles and 'Check needed' gate results, with on-navy text (5.0:1).

tokens.name: warning-700
tokens.usage: Text and icons on warning-50 (6.5:1): Reserved chip, Pending badge, warning banner.

tokens.name: warning-50
tokens.usage: Tint behind warning-700.

tokens.name: neutral-600
tokens.usage: Maintenance / Inactive status: solid tile fill with on-navy text (7.6:1), or chip text on surface-50.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the side panel.

styles.name: display

styles.usage: The one H1 per console page (page header).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Card, panel and modal titles; section headings inside a page.

styles.name: kpi

styles.usage: Marketing body; form fields and body copy in the mobile apps.
styles.sample: Live occupancy, employee passes and gate entry in one place.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default console text: tables, forms, panels. The minimum size for body copy.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Button labels, emphasised table cells, nav items.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Badges, table column headers, nav group labels. The smallest text allowed anywhere.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: parkflows.in only: the uppercase eyebrow above a section heading and the step numbers. Set text-transform: uppercase. Never in the console.

styles.name: mono-xs
styles.usage: Slot tile: the last 4 characters of the plate. The smallest mono size.

styles.name: mono-xs-strong
styles.usage: Slot tile: the slot code; small slot codes in dense lists.

styles.name: mono
styles.usage: Plates, slot codes, IDs and times inside tables and panels. Nothing else.

styles.name: mono-md
styles.usage: Slot card: the slot code (full card); the plate on the compact pallet card.

styles.name: mono-plate
styles.usage: Slot card: the plate, the most important line on the card. Its tracking is also used by mono plate inputs.

styles.name: mono-lg
styles.usage: The slot code on the gate result and the plate on the digital pass.

tokens.name: radius-full

tokens.name: shadow-1
tokens.usage: Cards and tables at rest (with a line-100 border).

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px white gap, then a solid 2px teal-600 ring. Never removed.

duration.note: Motion: only for transitions people trigger (hover, open, close). Status never pulses, pings or bounces. Under prefers-reduced-motion every duration is 0ms.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover, press, colour changes.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Opening modals, the side panel, menus, toasts. The maximum.

tokens.name: duration-spin
tokens.usage: One turn of the loading spinner. A loop period, not a transition, so the 200ms maximum does not apply. Under reduced motion it is 0ms and the spinner is static.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Every transition.

size.note: Fixed sizes for controls and touch targets.

tokens.name: control-lg
